COMPATIBILITY COMES FIRST

A wall bracket connects a pole to a building. The right choice depends on the pole, projection, wall construction and fixing design rather than appearance alone.

01

Pole compatibility

Identify the pole diameter and bracket configuration from product information. Send photos when replacing an existing fitting.

02

Building and placement

State the wall material, proposed position and any projection over a path or public area. Include landlord or property approvals.

03

Installation requirements

Fixing suitability cannot be established from an image alone. Any assessment or specialist work needed should be included in the agreed scope.

MAKE YOUR REQUEST USEFUL

A better brief.
A clearer quote.

Include photographs of the wall and intended display position, pole information and whether a bracket is being replaced or fitted for the first time.

Product options, compatibility, stock and lead times are confirmed for your request.

REQUEST A PARTS QUOTE

GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

Can a bracket be fitted to any wall?

No universal assumption should be made. The building, fixing substrate, selected product and display conditions must be considered together.

What if I do not know the model or dimensions?

Send the information you have, including existing records and photos taken from a safe position. Do not climb, dismantle or alter the display to complete the enquiry.
